description: $0.01 per call (x402, USDC on Base; the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). One call: a client-ready, evidence-backed website audit and remediation plan (SEO on up to 10 pages, passive security, links, email authentication, AI readiness). Every finding has evidence, observed/inferred basis, priority, effort, a concrete fix and how to verify it; plus a phased implementation plan, what needs human review, and an honest coverage section. JSON + Markdown + self-contained HTML, optional white-label branding. Passive, point-in-time; not a penetration test. Returns the finished site-report/1 or status "running" with result_url / delivery_id + key to poll (free tool site_report_status). Bad input is refused before payment; a report where every check fails is not charged.
